defs.def: a piece of cloth or paper used for drying things, especially your body 毛巾；手巾；抹布；纸巾verb

ex.s: When at last my hand would grab the edge of the pool, he would always be there with a warm, dry towel, telling me how proud he was of my desperate efforts.
ex.t: 第二周之后，每次更改课程表都需要付费。

ex.s: After brushing their teeth, they spit into a towel.
ex.t: 刷完牙后，他们把唾液吐到毛巾上。

ex.s: Just bring trainer and her classes are a towel and some water.
ex.t: 只需带上运动鞋，她的课需要一条毛巾和一些水。

ex.s: "Throwing in the towel" is another common idiom that comes from boxing.
ex.t: “扔白毛巾”（认输）是另一个源自拳击的常用习语。

ex.s: When a boxer is losing badly and is too tired or confused to give up on his or her own, the coach will literally throw a towel into the ring to end the fight.
ex.t: 当一名拳击手惨败，又累得或糊涂得无法自己认输时，教练会真的把一条毛巾扔进擂台，以此结束比赛。

ex.s: When at the hotel, we can reduce our impact by cutting back on water consumption and not having our bedding and towels washed every day.
ex.t: 住在酒店时，我们可以通过减少用水、不每天更换清洗寝具和毛巾来降低自己的影响。
